notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/f17365e0e654b0bec4444883b23206768fd230ff.png"][/img][/p][h1]Resource Changes:[/h1][p][b]1) Summon Damage Adjustment:[/b][/p][p]- Summoned Wolf: Maximum damage 20 (25 >> 20)[/p][p]- Summoned Skeleton: 15/25 (20/30 >> 15/25)[/p][p]- Summoned Elite Skeleton: 20/35 (30/40 >> 20/35)[/p][p]- Summoned Gorilla: Minimum damage 30 (35 >> 30)[/p][p]- Water/Earth Elemental: 65/80 (70/85 >> 65/80)[/p][p]- Wind Elemental: 70/85 (75/90 >> 70/85)[/p][p]- Fire Elemental: 75/90 (80/95 >> 75/90)[/p][p][b]2) Spells:[/b][/p][p]- Summon Wind Elemental: Requires 1030 mana to cast Casting (940 >> 1030)[/p][p]- Summon Fire Elemental: Requires 1200 mana to cast (1010 >> 1200)[/p][p][b]3) Mining:[/b][/p][p]Life and Regeneration Time values ​​have been updated to improve the mining quality of iron and silver ores.[/p][p][b]4) NPCs:[/b][/p][p]- Medusa: Reduces her EXP to 10,000 (10,400 >> 10,000)[/p]

It has been tested that the cooldown is correctly reduced with elven items.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="266"][p]#944 – fix_ForkArtifacts[/p][p]Hostile NPCs now rotate correctly when they have pets/elementals on their sides.[/p][p]Fixes artifacts left behind by previous repository forks; rescues a pending revert.[/p][/td][td][p]#944 – fix_ForkArtifacts[/p][p]Hostile NPCs now rotate correctly when they have pets/elementals on their sides.[/p][p]Fixes artifacts left behind by previous repository forks; rescues a pending revert.[/p][/td][td][p]#944 – fix_ForkArtifacts[/p][p]Hostile NPCs now rotate correctly when they have pets/elementals on their sides.[/p][p]Fixes artifacts left behind by previous repository forks; rescues a pending revert.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colspan="3" colwidth="266,0,0"][p]Lista de Cambios en Recursos:[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colspan="3" colwidth="266,0,0"][p]1) NPC Defense.[/p][p]The DEF of the following NPCs has been reduced: Mermaid, Galleon, Purple Deer, Black Deer, Sorceress, Fairy, Ogre, Mutinous Pirate, Cannoneer Pirate, Unleashed Wind Element, Unleashed Fire Element, Demonic Minion, Demonic Minion, Ghanly, Arctic Shaman.[/p][p]The DEF of the following NPCs has been adjusted: Captain Cedric (10), Specter (10), Forest Spirit (10), Warrior Ogre (10), Ancient Deer (10), Shark (5), Cryptococcus (5), Leviathan (10).[/p][p]Set DEF = 5 for Dungeon NPCs +27:[/p][p]- Arachnid Crusher, Azhran (Lair)[/p][p]- Lynn, Kadru (Nagas)[/p][p]- Ice Golem, Eyewarden (Glacier Cave)[/p][p]- Red Dragon, Gold (Dragon's Lair)[/p][p]- Witch, Medusa (Dragon Veril)[/p][p]2) Summons.[/p][p]The hit chance of the following NPCs has been reduced:[/p][p]- Skeleton: 240 >> 205[/p][p]- Piranha: 250 >> 210[/p][p]- Elite Skeleton: 245 >> 215[/p][p]- Scylla: 250 >> 230[/p][p]- Gorilla: 250 >> 230[/p][p]- Earth/Water Elemental: 275 >> 250 - minimum damage reduced by 5: 75 >> 70[/p][p]- Wind Elemental: 285 >> 260 - damage reduction 85/95 >> 75/90[/p][p]3) Robe/Armor Defense[/p][p]The defense values ​​of the following items have been updated:[/p][p]- Gray Robe: 7/9 >> 6/8[/p][p]- Red Robe: 8/10 >> 6/8[/p][p]- Blue Robe: 10/12 >> 8/10[/p][p]- Aquamarine Robe: 13/15 >> 10/12[/p][p]- Black Robe: 15/17 >> 13/15[/p][p]- Forgiving Dress: 15/17 >> 13/15[/p][p]- Necromancer's Robe: 17/19 >> 15/17[/p][p]- Wedding Dress: 17/19 >> 15/17[/p][p]- Ochre Robe: 17/21 >> 15/17[/p][p]- Red Forgiving Dress: 17/21 >> 15/17[/p][p]- Erendil's Garb: 18/22 >> 15/19[/p][p]- Natural Robe: 18/22 >> 15/19[/p][p]- Leather Armor: 7/9 >> 7/12[/p][p]- Blue Leather Armor: 9/11 >> 8/12[/p][p]- Armor Maghtere: 13/15 >> 11/15[/p][p]- Chainmail: 14/18 >> 15/19[/p][p]- Ebony Armor: 18/20 >> 19/21[/p][p]- Knight's Breastplate: 19/21 >> 20/22[/p][p]- Cloaked Armor: 20/22 >> 21/23[/p][p]- Plates of Honor: 25/29 >> 27/29[/p][p]- Items removed from sale and crafting: Gray Robe, Mage's Robe, and Countess's Dress.[/p][p]4) Spells[/p][p]The damage value of the following spells has been updated:[/p][p]- Magic Missile: reduced to 25/35 (30/40 >> 25/35)[/p][p]- Blazing Flare: minimum damage increased to 30 (25 >> 30)[/p][p]- Apocalypse: minimum spell damage increased from 91 to 92[/p][p]5) Quest[/p][p]- The Vulkan NPC in Kamal Village has been enabled: a new quest for the Mage class is available starting at level 31.[/p][p]6) Druid Pets[/p][p]Adjusted damage, hit, and attack interval for NPCs:[/p][p]- Sea Turtle / White Fang: 40/55 damage - 200 hit - 2s attack interval[/p][p]- Shark / Ursus: 55/70 damage - 220 hit - 2.1s attack interval[/p][p]- Cryptococcus / Winter Worg: 70/85 damage - 240 hit range - 2.2s attack interval[/p][p]- Black Panther: 85/100 damage - 260 hit range - 2.3s attack interval[/p][p]7) Weapons[/p][p]Damage adjustments for the following items:[/p][p]- Viking Sword: +2 min / -2 max: 5/15 >> 7/13[/p][p]- Katana: +1 min / -1 max: 8/16 >> 9/15[/p][p]- Double-Edged War Axe: +1 min: 10 >> 11[/p][p]- Shortsword: No longer equippable by the Hunter, Bard, and Assassin classes.[/p][p]8) NPC Graphics[/p][p]- Graphic and stats update for the Mediterranean Turtle NPC.[/p][p]- Graphic update for the Dragon Dungeon NPCs.[/p][p]- Graphic update for the Mermaid NPC.[/p][p]9) Damage and Magic Resistance Balance[/p][p]Magic Damage and Magic Resistance System Changes:[/p][p]- Increased the natural magic protection modifier from 0.03 to 0.04 (multiplied by Magic Resistance Skills)[/p][p]- Increased the mana recovered from the Elven Lute from 12 to 14[/p][p]Magic Damage Item Changes:[/p][p]- Elven Lute: from 6% to 7%[/p][p]- Flute: from 2% to 1%[/p][p]- Elven Flute: from 7% to 8%[/p][p]- Wooden Staff: from 3% to 2%[/p][p]- Gnarled Staff: from 6% to 4%[/p][p]- Socketed Staff: from 8% to 9%[/p][p]Magic Resistance Item Changes:[/p][p]- Wolf Helmet: from 3% to 2%[/p][p]- Ring of Magic Defense: 2% to 1%[/p][p]- Elk Antler: 6% to 5%[/p][p]- Apprentice Hat: 2% to 1%[/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Patch Notes (13/09/25)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/f17365e0e654b0bec4444883b23206768fd230ff.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Resource Changes:[/b][/p][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][p]Mage evasion reduced by 0.05 (0.20 >> 0.15),[/p][p]Druid evasion reduced by 0.05 (0.65 >> 0.60),[/p][p]Assassin NPC backstabbing multiplier reduced by 0.10 (1.60-1.90 >> 1.50-1.80),[/p][p]Cleric weapon damage increased by 0.05 (0.85 >> 0.90),[/p][p]Spells:[/p][p]A 5-second cooldown applied to the Summon Earth/Water/Wind/Fire Elemental cast,[/p][p]Fireburst: reduced damage to 25/40,[/p][p]Fire Echo: reduced damage to 35/45 and requires 5 more mana,[/p][p]Flash Mauve: Reduces its damage to 40/50 and requires 5 more mana.[/p][p]NPCs:[/p][p]Earth Elemental: Reduces its average damage by 5.[/p][p]Water Elemental: Reduces its average damage by 5.[/p][p]Summoned Gorilla: Reduces its average damage by 5.[/p][p]Items:[/p][p]Silver Sword: Increases minimum damage by 1 (11/20 >> 12/20).[/p][p]Sapphire Sword: Increases minimum damage by 1 (12/18 >> 13/18).[/p][p]Double-Edged War Axe: Increases minimum damage by 1 and reduces maximum damage by 1 (9/18 >> 10/17).[/p][p]Barbarian Axe: Reduces maximum damage by 1 (8/15 >> 8/14).[/p][p]Dagger +1: Reduces minimum and maximum damage by 1 (3/4 >> 2/3).[/p][p]Dagger +2: Reduces maximum damage by 1 point (3/6 >> 3/5),[/p][p]Dagger +3: Increases minimum damage by 1 point (4/7 >> 5/7),[/p][p]Dagger +4: Increases minimum damage by 1 point (5/8 >> 6/8),[/p][p]Dark Garb: Reduces maximum defense by 2 points (25/29 >> 25/27),[/p][p]Legendary Robe: Reduces average defense by 3 points (30/36 >> 27/33)[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Client Changes:[/b][/p][p]Implemented Backpacks, item animations, and bug fixes.[/p][p]Author: Centarios[/p][p]PR: #591 Characters can now equip backpacks that render behind them! Additionally, backpacks have moving and idle animations (the first item type in the game to achieve this). Also fixed issues with clicking on non-pet NPCs and with the display of Game Master name colors. Finally, backpack display has been added to the character selection screen.[/p][p]Cleaned up unused message keys and fixed typos in translations.[/p][p]Author: Temis-gt[/p][p]PR: #590 Removed unused message keys (ARM_MESSAGE, LEGION_MESSAGE, COUNCIL_MESSAGE, and COUNCIL_MESSAGE) from the language files. Also fixed a typo in the 'CHAOS_STATE_MESSAGE_THIRD_HIERARCHY' key and a spelling error in the Spanish translation of 'ROYAL_COUNCIL_STATE_MESSAGE'.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Server Changes:[/b][/p][p]Removed duplicate clan names in the guild request history.[/p][p]Author: aledg994[/p][p]PR: #940 The guild request and membership history will now display unique clan names, removing repetition and improving clarity. Information.[/p][p]Added property to display an NPC's killer in the console.[/p][p]Author: aledg994[/p][p]PR: #941 Some NPCs will now display who killed them in the game console! This new feature will allow players to keep track of who is defeating certain special enemies.[/p]

notes.title: Dragon Heart: Vol. II
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/6b37b10a58c060820ddbd5a48e6563a5f7ba1854.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Attention Argentum Online adventurers![/p][p]This Sunday, September 14th at 8:00 PM, a new installment of the Dragon Dungeon event will begin: the Heart of the Blue Dragon! Over the course of 14 days, a new creature will emerge within this dungeon. Those brave enough to defeat it will have the opportunity to collect its Heart.[/p][p]The challenge is to defeat the creature and try to accumulate 50 hearts during the event, in order to participate in an exclusive raffle that will take place during a live stream at the end of the event, on Sunday, September 28th at 10:00 PM.[/p][p]During the stream, those who have collected 50 hearts will be able to participate in an exclusive raffle for a Dragon Mount. There are five mounts up for grabs, so there will be multiple winners. So prepare, strengthen your strategies, and don't miss this incredible opportunity to hunt and win.[/p][p]The Heart of the Blue Dragon awaits![/p]

notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/f17365e0e654b0bec4444883b23206768fd230ff.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Resource Changes:[/b][/p][p]A new quest (+29) is available in Eleusis to obtain the Polar Traveler's Coat.[/p][p]Access to the second floor of the Dragon Dungeon (+31) has been enabled.[/p][p]Body replacements have been added to the Guardian Orc, Tiger, Bengal Tiger, and Stone Golem NPCs.

Biweekly rotation of Patreon Items, which are updated in the Game Manual.[/p][p][b]Client Code Changes:[/b][/p][p]PR#580 Added validation to prevent the /desc command from containing hyphens ("-"), @Centorios[/p][p]PR#581 Added a new setting to the game settings to change the visual appearance of the new equipment indicator. Additionally, the old equipment indicator (red '+') has been added as an alternative and is now configurable. @Centorios[/p][p]PR#585 Changed the sound effect when adjusting the game volume. @plusin[/p][p][b]Server code changes:[/b][/p][p]PR#924 Fixed a bug when throwing gold. @Centorios[/p][p]PR#925 Fixed a malfunction with Citizen status and their pets. @Centorios[/p][p]PR#926 Fixed a bug when connecting with Factionary Garb equipped. @Centorios[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes (04/09/25)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/f17365e0e654b0bec4444883b23206768fd230ff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Client][/b][/p][p]Continuous Walk: NPCs now correctly display movement sprites (PR#567)[/p][p]Refactoring and Localization of LookAtTile Messages[/p][p]Author: Centtorios PR: #570[/p][p]Optimized the protocol for LookAtTile messages for NPCs and characters. The client now receives the minimum information needed and handles its interpretation. Additionally, localization support has been added for all interaction-related messages when clicking on NPCs or characters.[/p][p]Fixed the creation and display of groups in event lobbies.[/p][p]Author: Centtorios PR: #562[/p][p]Adjusted lobby forms to ensure players enter correct values. Fixed the group type selector (previously forcing the event to be a hunt) and the group type in the lobbie list (previously displayed as a blank space).[/p][p]Forgat City has been removed as a hometown option.[/p][p]Author: Plus PR: #575[/p][p]New characters will now begin their adventure on the mainland. To access Forgat City, they must request permission from the Governor.[/p][p]Home screen logo update.[/p][p]Author: Temis-gt PR: #577[/p][p]The game's home screen image has been updated. The new logo appears when launching Argentum Online.[/p][p][b]\[Server][/b][/p][p]Factional items (Royal = 1 / Chaos = 1) can only be equipped in the Safe Zone (PR#913).[/p][p]Magic damage fix for Druid pets: they will now correctly add the bonus for having an equipped flute (PR#916).[/p][p]Improvements to the message system when clicking on a tile and finding a person or NPC. All messages involving clicking on an NPC or person are now translated. The form for creating a lobby from the event creator NPC is now working correctly. Fixed an issue where a hunt would be created when trying to set the group mode. The form now allows you to create all lobby types except the generic one. The blacksmithing form now only shows the items needed to create the item (previously, it showed all materials even if the weapon crafting cost for that item was 0). Added a platform for making professions grant experience.[/p][p]For now, fishing with rods with a power greater than 2 (reinforced, iron, or net) will grant 1 experience point upon successful fishing (does not scale by quantity).[/p][p]Added NPC engagement when using immobilize or paralyze.[/p][p]Increased the time an NPC spends in combat with a user from the last spell or hit cast from 10 to 15 seconds.[/p][p]Optimized the way messages are sent when observing characters and NPCs, reducing the amount of data transmitted. Additionally, localization has been implemented for all interaction-related messages when clicking on them. Author: Centarios PR: #919[/p][p][/p][p][b]**New Element System Programming:**[/b][/p][p]- Added the "elemental" property to NPCs and ITEMS (not yet assigned).[/p][p]- Added functionality for persistence of user-applied elements when:[/p][p]> Throwing an enchanted item on the ground.[/p][p]> Depositing an enchanted item in the bank.[/p][p]> Move an enchanted item in the inventory[/p][p]> Trade an enchanted item between users.[/p][p]- Added "Elemental Runes" craftable by blacksmiths (not yet balanced)[/p][p]- The Alchemy "recipe" system has been ported to other professions (not yet balanced)[/p][p]- The system will now have four Elements (Fire, Water, Earth, Wind)[/p][p]- Added Element interaction with NPCs for both hits and spells (as long as the elemental weapon is equipped)[/p][p]- Added the ability to enchant an item by dragging an elemental rune onto it.[/p][p]- All implementation will be handled by a feature toggle (in case it needs to be enabled/disabled)[/p][p]- The Blodium deposit has been reinstated in the server code.[/p][p]- Added 4 new crafting requirements for Elemental Runes called "essences."[/p][p]- Added the Element interaction matrix to the Balance.ini file for future damage adjustments.[/p][p]- Added new special effects when enchanting an item.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Resources][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]NPCs:[/b][/p][p]Set the LEVEL=24 property for Dragon Dungeon NPCs.[/p][p]Updated the graphics for Forest Gorilla, Arctic Gorilla, and Goblin.[/p][p]Shortened the text for World Bankers.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Items:[/b][/p][p]Added maximum level restriction for item use:[/p][p]Town Crier's Attire[/p][p]Blue Cloaked Robe[/p][p]Duke's Attire[/p][p]Alcarinqua Gala Dress[/p][p]Duchess's Dress[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes (22/08/25)
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/7d461cbc1c2422b746b19324de5dd29e1059e7d4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Server][/b][/p][p]Anti-Cheat System Update.[/p][p]Author: Centtorios PR: #906[/p][p]Fixed issues to improve false positives due to timeouts.[/p][p]Fixed the required quest message to display the name correctly.[/p][p]Author: aledg994 PR: #904[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the message indicating the required quest did not display the quest name correctly. Message 1424 will now display the quest name in the console, making it easier to understand the requirements for progress.[/p][p]Hunters no longer resist double paralysis Author: 
Centtorios PR: #903 
The Hunter class was resistant to double paralysis. Additionally, bonus damage from weapons and accessories now stacks correctly, and stronger mods for high-level items have been added.[/p][p]New lava visual effect in the game.[/p][p]Author: ReyarB PR: #908[/p][p]A new visual effect has been implemented for lava in the game. notes.title: 🔥 📜 The Return of Dravonius – Event in Dungeon Marabel 🔥
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/8769b341d442ef5fdbe33e6e959c09d6cf47cfb0.png"][/img][b]
[/b]
📜 The Return of Dravonius[/p][p]Among the few dusty tomes that survive the passage of time, some tell of the history following the war between Gulfas Morgolock and some of his sons, who, rebelling with extreme violence and ferocity, attempted to conquer the lands of Argentum.[/p][p]One of his most powerful sons, Rangue, god of greed and deceit, conceived the idea of bringing into the world a profane and cursed being, created from his thoughts, as he had once been by Gulfas.[/p][p]Dravonius; he named this demon, who was not conceived of womb or earth, with an insatiable hunger for the souls of the innocent. With horns like spears, skin red as blood, and a burning trident, Dravonius led legions of demons from the abyss, until the union of men, elves, and dwarves managed to destroy his body and seal his remains within the depths.[/p][p]For centuries, it was believed his fire had been extinguished… but all the blood spilled this year and the influence of the Dark Legion finally weakened the seals that bound the demon.[/p][p]Rumors of dark sacrifices and echoes of a trident dragging across the icy stone herald the unthinkable: Dravonius has regained enough strength to take material form once more.[/p][p]Now he walks the caverns of Marabel once more, gathering his progeny and spreading corruption.[/p][p]Only the bravest adventurers will be able to stand against him.[/p][p]Acyd Snow, Role Master [/p][p][/p][p]🔹 Objective: Contain the Dravonius threat[/p][p]🔹 Recommended level: 20 - 24[/p][p]🔹 Event starts: Tuesday, August 5, 2025 at 10:00 PM[/p][p]🔹 Duration: Wednesday, August 13, 2025 at 10:00 PM[/p]

notes.title: # 🗞️ Argentum Online (Web) – Dev Update (Últimos 15 Días)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/6465054a5333e405e3022023eca6442e9b80b05e.png"][/img]**July 2025**[/p][p]Over the past two weeks, we've made key advancements in internationalization and new features. Below, we'll share the most significant updates:[/p][p]## 🧰 Developer Tools: Index Creation[/p][p]- Updated and refactored the `IndexByLanguage.bas` file to better handle localized data.[/p][p]- Added an **automatic index creator by language**, facilitating future content expansions.[/p][p]- Minor changes to forms (`Form1.frm`) and project files to improve maintainability and consistency.[/p][p]- All **spells now have multilingual support** for names and descriptions.[/p][p]- Fixed inconsistent and duplicate translations in index files.[/p][p]- Fixed bugs related to **NPC display names**.[/p][p]- Improved internal spell name processing to ensure proper localization by language.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 🌍 Multilanguage Support[/p][p]Argentum Online now supports more than one language![/p][p]- Added translation support for NPC, item, spell, and quest names and descriptions.[/p][p]- The website now automatically remembers your preferred language.[/p][p]- Improved display of translated items on both desktop and mobile.[/p][p]- The wiki and perk pages are now also translated.[/p][p]This change opens the door to a more global community.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## 🛠️ Visual Improvements and Fixes[/p][p]- Improved design for the character sales and details section in the user dashboard.[/p][p]- Improved mobile navigation and fixed a bug in the language switcher.[/p][p]- Fixed confusing text and **clearer error messages**.[/p][p]- Removed duplicate translations and added missing ones.[/p][p]- Added an **animated marquee** with the owners visible during the process.[/p][p]---[/p][p]## Coming Soon - 🏠 Player-to-Player House Swapping[/p][p]A long-awaited feature is coming: **house swapping**.[/p][p]- New system for **exchanging properties**.[/p][p]- A **confirmation screen with the exchange cost** is now displayed.[/p][p]We continue working to improve your experience in Argentum Online. Thank you for joining us 🚀[/p]

This NPC offers a quest for each horse and rewards those who own a mount.[/p][p]- Horses are now purchased on Map 188 (Penthar's Farm), and the horseshoes needed to complete Rider Quests are sold in Ullathorpe. Quest reward items (those with a number) are CONSUMABLE and grant a movement speed boost; the effect is permanent.[/p][p]- The "Arachnid Mutant Rein" and "Red Dragon Rein" items awarded in Events now have a standard speed of 1.05 and are transferable.[/p][p]- The Speed per Level values are as follows:[/p][p]Level 1: 1.05[/p][p]Level 2: 1.07[/p][p]Level 3: 1.10[/p][p]Level 4: 1.15[/p][p]Level 5: 1.20[/p][p]Level 6: 1.25[/p][p]All this information will be added to the Wiki in the coming days.[/p][p][/p][p]\[FACTION POINTS][/p][p]- When you get a kill on a character of a higher level than your own, the score obtained scales by 1 faction point for each higher level of your enemy, up to a maximum of 20 points.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Server:[/p][p]Faction Point bonuses for level differences and kills between rival factions.[/p][p]Author: JuanCruzRossa[/p][p]Improvements have been made to the faction point system. The gameplay experience will now be more consistent with sound feedback.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Client:[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed data types in Quests (greater than 255) in frmQuests.[/p][p]Author: Centarios[/p][p]Fixed data types in the Quests form to match server data types, avoiding uncontrolled type conversions.[/p][p]PR: #539[/p][p]
[/p][p]Added "Legionary Secure" system.[/p][p]Author: JuanCruzRossa[/p][p]Implemented the "Legionary Secure" system.[/p][p]PR: #537[/p][p]

notes.title: Griffo Island
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/18b521d5e0343a518f2d6a14fc583b213207f42a.png"][/img][/p][p]Nix has its fishing guild, Ullathorpe prides itself on its master carpenters, but Arghal… Arghal has Baldros Featherwick, naturalist, explorer, and navigator-cartographer.[/p][p]Today, the eccentric adventurer stands atop a crate of supplies in the eastern harbor, his voice piercing the mists, inviting all:[/p][p]“Adventurers! Heed my call! I have crossed storms and overcome treacherous currents. I have charted islands uncharted and seen horrors I would rather forget. But what I found on my last voyage… my friends, is a paradise on the brink of extinction.”[/p][p]“An island hidden in the mists harbors a noble and forgotten race: the Griffins. Majestic, fierce, intelligent. But their kind is in danger. A strange creature—a lizard of alarming size—has begun to hunt their eggs. If we do not intervene, they will soon be only legend.”[/p][p]Baldros removes the damp cloth covering a small box. Inside, a mottled egg, warm to the touch, emits a faint golden glow.[/p][p]“I need brave hands, determined hearts. Those who defend the nests and protect the island… may be worthy of something more: Raising their own griffon!”[/p][p][/p][p]🧭 The expedition will depart soon from Arghal Harbor[/p][p]📜 Join the event and discover the wildness of the unknown![/p][p]⚔️ Battle the invasive lizards[/p][p]🦅 Breed your unique mount![/p]

notes.title: Special Faction Event
notes.content:
[p]⚔️ [b]Special Faction Event in Argentum Online![/b] ⚔️[/p][p]🗓 Start: [i]July 1, 2025 - 10:00 PM (Argentina time)
[/i][/p][p]Prepare for a new era of conflict and choice in Argentum Online! The forces of the Royal Navy and the Dark Legion are preparing for an unprecedented confrontation, where Honor, Power, and above all, Forgiveness will be at stake.[/p][p]For 14 days, two ancient and renowned representatives will meet in both faction castles, who will undoubtedly shape the fate of both factions.[/p][p]In the Royal Navy castle, alongside King [b]Tancred[/b], the venerable [b]Tharion[/b] will offer a crucial mission to all citizens who wish to return to the Kingdom.[/p][p]Meanwhile, in the gloomy castle of [b]Elanrulk[/b], the bloodthirsty [b]Vorthenak[/b] will entrust a similar task to the future followers of the Dark Legion.[/p][p]The objective for both sides will be to fight to obtain the difficult Shield Drop from both Factionary Guards. Once they do, they must complete the Quest and store the Factionary Forgiveness Gem until the end of the event.[/p][p]On July 14th, at 10:00 PM, those who deliver this Gem will receive the [b][u]Factionary Forgiveness[/u][/b] and will be able to Enlist in their respective Castle.[/p][p]This event marks a unique opportunity to redefine your story in the game. Will you remain in the shadows or fight for the light?[/p][p]The war for the fate of Argentum has begun![/p]

[b]Server:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shield deflection probability is now configurable. Author: Centarios PR: #848[/p][/*][/list][p]The shield deflection probability system has been modified. Shield effectiveness can now be configured using a percentage property. A percentage of 100% maintains the current effectiveness, while lower values ​​reduce the shield's effectiveness proportionally. Cosmetic shields can still be set to 0.[/p][list][*][p]Improved validation for the use of unsupported macros. Author: ReyarB PR: #859[/p][/*][/list][p]Strengthened validation for the use of unsupported macros, ensuring that only defined spells can activate them. Code readability has been improved and the groundwork has been paved for future implementations of unsupported spells.[/p][list][*][p]Experience and level bonuses for groups with leadership. Author: Centtorios PR: #852 (UNDER REVIEW) A +1 bonus has been added to the party level delta for characters with Leadership equal to or greater than 15 (Charisma/2). A configurable bonus (currently 1%) has also been added to the experience gained for all party members who meet the Leadership requirement.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Leadership bonus implementation reverted. Author: RecoX PR: #865[/p][/*][/list][p]Leadership bonus functionality has been temporarily reverted due to a bug preventing server compilation. This reversion is intended to ensure game stability while the underlying issue is investigated and resolved.[/p][list][*][p]English localization improvements. Author: ReyarB PR: #861[/p][/*][/list][p]Updates and fixes have been made to the English translation of several game modules, including Tournaments, Events, and Punishments. Additionally, message identifiers have been corrected.[/p][list][*][p]Refactoring of helmet and head assignment logic. Author: ReyarB PR: #862[/p][/*][/list][p]The internal logic for assigning helmets and heads to characters has been refactored. This improves code maintainability and paves the way for future implementations of new types of headgear. No functional changes visible to the player have been introduced.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Macro detection refactoring and improvements. Author: ReyarB PR: #864[/p][/*][/list][p]The macro detection system has been optimized for clarity and maintainability by unifying calls and centralizing logic. Game behavior remains the same, but the internal structure is now cleaner and more scalable, preparing the code for future improvements to macro detection.[/p][list][*][p]PvE Bard class update. Author: Temis-gt PR: #855[/p][/*][/list][p]Adjustments have been made to the Bard class, including declaring variables for lyres, modernizing spell-related code, and introducing meditation bonuses based on the equipped lyre.[/p][list][*][p]Increased maximum imprisonment time. Author: aledg994 PR: #863[/p][/*][/list][p]The maximum time a character can be jailed has been increased.[/p][list][*][p]Automated server, index builder, and client launch. Author: plusin PR: #851[/p][/*][/list][p]Added a BAT script that automates the startup of the server, index builder, and game client. It requires the files to be located in the "C:\\AO20" folder.
[/p][p][b]Client:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pets no longer make noise when walking. Author: Wyr0X PR: #527[/p][/*][/list][p]Pet and summoned creature footstep sounds have been removed to reduce overall noise pollution and make it easier to spot invisible players.[/p][list][*][p]Added a link to the Steam graph to the /showconsole command. Author: Centtorios PR: #526[/p][/*][/list][p]The /showconsole command now displays a direct link to the Argentum Online activity graph on Steam.[/p][list][*][p]Changed the variable type for jail time. Author: aledg994 PR: #528[/p][/*][/list][p]The variable type that stores jail time has been changed from byte to integer. This allows for greater precision and prevents potential overflows when calculating sentence time.[/p][list][*][p]Added a window for selecting skins. notes.title: Patch Notes (29/05/25)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/c6e2b240a928cf2ed9d3168a22cbf642282a78d7.png[/img]

[b]Server:[/b]

- Implemented faction chat via console.
Author: aledg994 PR: #830
A new faction chat system has been implemented. Players will be able to communicate with members of their faction using the /FMSG command. Requires an update in the game client.

- Translated clan messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #836
Translated clan messages have been implemented, allowing for better communication between members of different languages.

- Gold has been refunded when canceling the Capture the Flag event due to a lack of players.
Author: Centtorios PR: #838
Now, if the Capture the Flag event is automatically canceled due to not enough players, the gold used for registration will be refunded.

- Fixed handling of localized messages in the protocol.
Author: ReyarB PR: #840
Fixed a protocol error that prevented localized messages from displaying correctly in certain cases. Messages should now display correctly for all players.

- Implemented the Arena system on the server.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #839
Implemented server-side logic for the Arena system, allowing players to interact with specific NPCs to enter arenas. Requires client-side implementation to fully function.

- Updated the arena entry message due to lack of gold.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #842
The message displayed when a user attempts to enter the arena and does not have enough gold has been updated. The message ID 2040 now appears.

- Increased the maximum entry price for maps.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #841
The maximum value that can be set as the entry price for a map has been increased.

- Lindos Arena is now a zone where potions are not consumed.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #843
The game has been modified so that when in Lindos Arena, potions are not consumed upon use.

- Improvements to the logic for areas without potions and arena validation.
Author: RecoX PR: #845
Improvements have been made to the function that defines zones where potions cannot be used. The code is now more readable and maintainable, and arena-specific validation has been added to ensure proper operation.

▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃ ▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃ ▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃

[b]Client:[/b]

- Implemented faction chat via console.
Author: aledg994 PR: #518
Faction members can now communicate with each other using the /FMSG command. Requires PR #830 to be accepted into the server repository.

- Fixed missing client IDs.
Author: ReyarB PR: #524
Fixed bugs related to some missing client IDs. This improvement should resolve connection and stability issues for some users.

- Implemented the /ARENA command on the client.
Author: acolote1998 PR: #523
The /ARENA command has been implemented, allowing users to interact with an NPC to enter an arena. This implementation sends the necessary information to the server.

▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃ ▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃ ▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃▃

[b]Spells:[/b]
- Paralyze time adjustment on the following spells:
Petrify: Stops the actions of NPCs for 90 seconds.
Paralyze: Stops the user's actions for 13 seconds. If the victim is an NPC, paralyzes them for 78 seconds.
Immobilize/Stun: Prevents the user from moving for 15 seconds. If the victim is an NPC, the effect lasts 90 seconds.

[b]Mapping:[/b]
- Drain (access from Banderbill and Arkhein cities)
The required level for entry has been raised to 18 (13 >> 18).
The HP, EXP, GLD, MIN-MAX HIT, and EVASION stats for the "MUD ANOMALY" and "SCALE CRAWLER" NPCs have been updated.

Lindos Arena:
- New dueling system! From now on, you can visit the Lindos Arena and battle with your friends for hours on end! To enter, click on the NPC, type the /Arena command, and pay the 5,000 gold entry fee. Mana, Life, Strength, and Agility potions will not be consumed while you remain inside! You can revive yourself by going up the stairs, but keep in mind that if you leave the Arena, you'll have to pay again to enter.

- Fixed mapping errors on maps: 1, 7, 8, 11, 15, 17, 19, 20, 21, 30, 34, 53, 61, 67, 69, 70, 71, 81, 82, 85, 90, 97, 98, 107, 111, 114, 119, 122, 129, 136, 137, 160, 161, 171, 181, 183, 185, 195, 202, 203, 244, 246, 255, 273, 276, 284, 285, 288, 297, 299, 301, 302, 303, 344, 353, 355, 356, 364, 375, 378, 379, 380, 391, 408, 409, 418, 424, 453, 473, 477, 483, 484, 487, 494, 498, 538, 541, 557, 560, 598 (ReyarB)

[b]Interface:[/b]
- Updated the interfaces for the fishing spots, shop, patreon, and group windows as they contained outdated information (Animal)

notes.title: Patch Notes (24/05/25)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/dd53d8ba1b1c910211e4c64b1a4a280321ccf502.png[/img]

[b]Server:[/b]

- Initial module documentation and component diagrams added.
PR: #828 Author: lordtiva
Documentation in Markdown format (.md) and Mermaid component diagrams (.mmd) have been introduced for several modules in the Code/ directory. This provides a better understanding of the game architecture and facilitates development.

- Fix: Fixed an issue where character heads were not saving.
PR: #831 Author: ReyarB
Fixed a bug that prevented character head appearances from being saved correctly. Now, when you change your character's head, it will be saved correctly and permanently.

- Added an identifier to the ModLlaves.bas module.
PR: #833 Author: ReyarB
An identifier has been added to the ModLlaves.bas module. This helps with code organization and maintenance.

- Fixed tabs in the code.
PR: #832 Author: ReyarB
Tabbing issues have been fixed in the source code. This improvement contributes to code readability and maintainability.

- Cleaned up the message protocol.
PR: #834 Author: morgolock
Unused messages have been removed from the protocol, contributing to greater efficiency and code cleanliness.

[b]Client:[/b]

- New message identifiers for faction chat.
PR: #520 Author: aledg994
New message IDs have been added to improve faction chat functionality.

- Fixed a compilation error.
PR: #522 Author: morgolock
eSendTelemetry and WriteSendTelemetry have been removed to address a compilation error.

NPCs:[/b]
- Added new graphics for the Great Red Dragon and Great Black Dragon from Dungeon Dragon.
- Fixed Summoned Gorilla: Increases minimum damage to 40 (35 >> 40).
- Fixed the Patreon Item Vendor Items window.

OBJs:[/b]
- Fixed the "Face Potion" item now correctly saves the face after consumption and correctly records it on the character.

[b]Spells:[/b]
- Petrify (NPC): Stops the actions of NPCs for 60 seconds (previously 120 seconds).
- Paralyze: Paralyzes the user for 12 seconds (previously 15 seconds). If the victim is an NPC, paralyzes them for 72 seconds.
- Immobilize/Stun: Stops the user's actions for 10 seconds (previously 20 seconds). If the victim is an NPC, immobilizes them for 60 seconds.

notes.title: Patch Notes (22/05/25)
notes.content:
[b]Server:[/b]

- Validation of user descriptions against banned words.
Author: aledg994 PR: #796
A system was implemented to prevent users from using offensive words or phrases in their descriptions. The game will now automatically check descriptions against a list of banned terms.

- Implemented visual effects for hitting and stabbing.
Author: aledg994 PR: #819
Visual effects have been added to the game. Taking damage from hitting will now display a blood effect. Taking stabbed damage will now display a distinctive visual effect.

- Fixed a compilation error when renaming a subroutine.
Author: aledg994 PR: #820
Fixed a compilation error caused by an incorrect name in a subroutine call. This fix ensures that the game compiles correctly.

- Refactoring of the potion consumption logic and addition of potion-free zones.
Author: RecoX PR: #821
The potion consumption logic has been refactored to improve code readability and maintainability. A new function, IsPotionFreeZone, has been introduced to centralize the conditions that determine whether a user is in a zone where potions are not consumed (tournament zones, training zones, etc.). This simplifies the main code and makes the logic easier to understand.

- Unified and consistent welcome message.
Author: ReyarB PR: #823
The welcome message has been modified to be consistent in all cases, providing a clear and consistent message for all players.

- Fixed missing value in donations.
Author: ReyarB PR: #824
Fixed an issue where a value was missing when processing donations, ensuring they were recorded correctly.

- NPC names displayed by ID for better localization.
Author: ReyarB PR: #822
The server now sends the NPC's ID number instead of the name. This allows the client to use the correct language when displaying the NPC's name.

- Added IDs for clan messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #829
Unique identifiers have been added to clan messages. This internal technical improvement facilitates future development and management of communication within clans.

- Migration of login and logout messages to JSON.
Author: ReyarB PR: #826
The structure of login and logout messages has been modified to use the JSON format, improving internal data management.

[b]Client:[/b]

- Fixed missing text in the Harassed Inn shop menu.
Author: ReyarB PR: #511
Fixed a bug in the Hosted Inn shop menu where the word "valor" was missing. JSON was used to handle Spanish and English text, ensuring that both languages ​​display the correct information.

- Message localization update.
Author: ReyarB PR: #513
Multilingual support was implemented in the FrmQuestInfo form by converting two messages to IDs. Additionally, several DisplayError messages were migrated to IDs to support multiple languages. The Trainer message and new text were added to the 1.json and 2.json files.

- IDs were implemented for error messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #514
Static error messages were replaced with IDs, which will allow for future game localization and multi-language support.

- Game menus are now translated and localized.
Author: ReyarB PR: #515
Interaction menus with non-player characters (NPCs), Game Masters (GMs), and other users will now be displayed in the language selected in-game. This improvement provides a more intuitive and accessible experience for all players.

- Updated NPC name localization.
Author: ReyarB PR: #512
The way the server sends NPC name information has been updated. The client now resolves the name based on the language only in specific messages that contain the NPC's name. Other messages will remain unchanged.

- New format for localized clan messages.
Author: ReyarB PR: #516
The clan message system has been updated to support a new format that allows for better localization and customization. Messages will now display more accurate information that is adaptable to different languages.

- Added support for empty labels in the game interface.
Author: ReyarB PR: #517
Labels have been added to indicate empty fields in the game interface, improving clarity and user experience in both Spanish and English.

[b]Spells:[/b]
- Summon Gorilla (NEW): Available for sale in the city of Eleusis, only for the BARD and CLERIC classes.

[b]Items:[/b]
- Arrow +2: Now requires level 25 to use (no longer sold, only for carpentry).
- Elven Arrow: Now requires level 33 to use.

- Buckler: Increases its max defense to 4 (3 >> 4)
- Wizard Hat: Reduces its min/max defense to 8/12 (previously 14/16)
- Reinforced Buckler: Increases its min/max defense to 4/6 (previously 3/5)
- High Wizard Hat: Reduces its min/max defense to 11/15 (previously 17/19)
- Oaken Shield: Increases its min/max defense to 6/8 (previously 5/7)
- Valley Shield: Reduces its max defense to 9 (10 >> 9)
- Sorcerer's Hat: Reduces its min/max defense to 15/19 (previously 21/23)
- Ebony Armor: Increases its min/max defense to 18/20 (previously 17/19)
- Knight's Breastplate: Increases its min/max defense to 19/21 (previously 18/20)
- Cloaked Armor: Increases min/max defense to 20/22 (previously 19/21)

[b]Quest:[/b]
- New quest for characters who have previously completed "Leviathan's Fiery Heart." Requires a minimum level of 27, grants a damage boost to the PvE spell Blaze of Fire, consumes 85 mana, and requires 67 Magic skills. The NPC is in Forgat.
- "Clear the Entrance" fix: This quest is only allowed from level 10 to level 15 inclusive.
- "Final Rest" fix: This quest is only allowed from level 9 to level 14 inclusive, and grants 590 XP and 125 gold.

[b]NPCs:[/b]
- The Silver Golem NPC has been added to Map 52 (Depths of the Mines): its respawn time ranges from 21,600 to 36,000 seconds and it has a guaranteed drop rate of 50 Silver Ingots.
- Medusa: grants 10,400 experience points (11,200 >> 10,400)

notes.title: Patch Notes (15/05/25)
notes.content:
[b]Server:[/b]

- The maximum number of steps for pathfinding can now be configured.
Author: morgolock PR: #816
Added the ability to configure the maximum number of steps NPCs will take while pathfinding. This can be modified in the Config.ini file via the NPCMaxStepsPathFinding variable.

- NPCs now have a configurable maximum vision range.
Author: morgolock PR: #817
Added the ability to configure NPCs' maximum vision range from a file, with a limit of 50.

- Increased NPC maximum vision.
Author: ReyarB PR: #818
Adjusted NPC maximum vision. This will affect the range at which NPCs detect players and other characters in the game.

[b]Client:[/b]

notes.title: As they saw that it resisted, they went to call another spider... 🍺
notes.content:
(Chapter III - Final)

For days, the people responded to the call. In the square of Ullathorpe, in front of the fountain, Governor Robert welcomed the adventurers and their backpacks filled with Arachnid Oothecas. The best were rewarded with keys to the deepest levels of the Catacombs and appointed protectors.
Peace seemed to have been established again; Thorgin could finally continue building his tavern, and some miners returned to the tunnels in search of coal.

The next morning, reality awoke everyone: the miners appeared torn to pieces, their bodies bearing cuts, bruises, and pustules where the poison dripped in drops. The only survivor was Murgan, a young orc with close-cropped hair and a somewhat vacant look, covered in bandages and wearing a sling on his arm. He is quickly brought before the governor.

[i]“Lord Robert, I'm sorry. The group grew complacent, thinking it was all over. We went deeper still in search of new minerals. We found the first levels empty, just as they were before the spiders, but when we entered a corridor we had never explored before, we saw her.

A spider as horrible as it was giant, barely able to enter the tunnels, let out a shriek so loud and high-pitched that we had to cover our ears. Within seconds, spiders surrounded us. They were different, much bigger, stronger, and faster than the previous ones. We began to run; some stumbled, others lost their torches, remaining in the darkness below.

It was a miracle I survived, but the slaughter of the huntsman spiders and their eggs awakened the mother, and she's coming for us.”[/i]

🔹 [b]Objective: [/b]
Defend the city of Ullathorpe from the attack of [b]Ghulvara[/b], the Matriarch Arachnid.

notes.title: Premium Inventory Slots Are Back – Starting April 23rd!
notes.content:
[b]Premium Inventory Slots Are Back – Starting April 23rd![/b]



Greetings adventurers,

We’re excited to announce that Premium Inventory Slots are making their return to Argentum Online — and the patch goes live on [b]April 23rd[/b]!

[b]What are Premium Slots?[/b]  
These are extra rows in your character’s inventory unlocked through an active Patreon subscription. Depending on your tier, you’ll gain more space for loot, resources, and rare items:

Aventurero: +1 extra row  
Héroe: +2 extra rows  
Leyenda: +3 extra rows

[b]Important – Please Read Carefully[/b]  
Starting April 23rd, if you reduce or cancel your subscription, you will lose access to the premium rows that don’t match your current tier.  
Any items stored in inaccessible rows will be automatically deleted when you log in to the game.

[b]To help you manage this:[/b]  
- Characters with items in premium-only slots will now receive in-game alerts in MAO.  
- You can always check your current subscription tier from the 'My Account' section on our website.

To avoid losing important items, please verify your subscription status before entering the game.

Thank you for supporting AO — your contributions help us grow and keep the world alive!

— The Argentum Online Team

In the center of [b]Ullathorpe[/b], east of the fountain, among the stones stands [b]Robert[/b], the governor. The town has been in a state of flux in recent weeks, as new and old faces gather again. Urging his advisors who were arguing with the crowd and quickly calling for silence, he exclaimed:

As an emergency measure, he called on the lone adventurers and clans of the Argentum Lands to prevent the spread of This invasive species. We must delve into the depths of the catacombs and eliminate the arachnid advance!

notes.title: A howl in the darkness (Ending Lore)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/b82eeea7bda30e4df319484fe2086a60a61c6eee.jpg[/img]

[b]Symbol of Peace[/b]

Edric looked at his hands; blood and mud drew strange shapes on his skin. At his feet, Bodolf's claws still clutched torn shreds of his grey cloak. The beast lay with a mortal wound in its chest; a well-aimed and calculated blow to its thigh had caused it to lower its guard, and with a second attack, Edric unleashed the full fury of his steel.

Now, after the lycanthrope's last breath, he was able to catch his breath and clear his eyes. Behind the body, on the ground, next to the cave wall, the bags of gold rested on the wet stone. A strange symbol engraved on them caught his eye: a laurel wreathed in flames. He hoisted them onto his back and set off back to the town.

The rain, which had begun in the last few miles of the journey, made the last stretch even more exhausting. Mud accumulated on his boots, and the weight of the gold on his shoulders drained what remained of his strength.

When the walls of Arghal rose before him, the town seemed even more gloomy than when he had set out. The drizzle accentuated the grey tones of the cobbled streets, and the apathetic faces of the townspeople barely spared him a glance as he advanced.

With a firm but tired step, he headed towards the centre of the town. However, something out of the corner of his eye made him stop immediately. At his side, imposing even in the dim light of the rain, stood the ancient abbey of Arghal. From the side street where he stood, he could make out the finely carved marble symbols above its entrance: an olive branch surrounded by flames.

Without wasting a second, he headed for the town hall.

The old building had seen better days. Its only decoration was the wood eaten away by the years and the salt that the sea wind pushed up to its walls.

As soon as he entered, the governor's dark eyes opened in surprise. They scanned him up and down quickly. Then, seeing the bags of gold, her expression hardened.

Regaining her composure, her voice turned cold and sharp:

[i]"Adventurer, you were supposed to die in the cave."[/i]

She raised her voice, pointed at Edric and concluded:

[i]"Quick! Hide the gold. Imprison him and cover his mouth. Tomorrow the public execution will take place."[/i]


Credits: Acid Snow

notes.title: Robbery on the high seas! (Lore)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/9560ce2d4457a29216cfca19c176aac042754edd.png[/img]

In the vast Shark Sea, where waves roar with fury and winds carry rumors of treasure and tragedy,
the sun was already setting behind the horizon when a convoy of merchants,
loaded with weapons from the Blacksmith House in the city of Nix,
set sail for the city of Forgat. The ships, strong and well protected,
had no idea that a deadly threat lurked in their wake.

The Emberfang, the flagship of the pirate crew led by Captain Low,
emerged from the fog like a spectre. From its black flag flew a skull,
a symbol of its ruthless crew, who mercilessly stalked the maritime trade routes.
Aboard the Emberfang, Captain Low watched, unperturbed, the transit of the ships.
His eyes, as cold as ice, shone with a dangerous glow as he planned his attack.

The captain had received information about a valuable cargo that could turn the tide of many battles.
With a low shout, he gave the order and the Emberfang launched the boarding.
The waves battered the vessels of the convoy as the pirates, with skill and dexterity, assaulted the ships one by one.
The merchants, surprised and terrified, could do little against the speed of the attackers.
Chaos broke out at sea, and within minutes, the cargo of weapons was transferred to the Emberfang's holds,
while the plundered ships slowly sank into the depths.
Captain Low, satisfied with the loot, looked at his crew and ordered them to retreat to an island to the north.
There, in the hidden ports, his men could divide the loot and hide the stolen weapons,
preparing for future sale on the black market.
But the echoes of this attack did not remain silent.
The surviving merchants reached the coast with stories of what had happened.
The news spread quickly, and now the city of Nix, the region of Arkhein and even the town of Forgat
cry out for the recovery of these weapons, fearing that they will fall into the wrong hands.

We invite you, brave adventurer, to join the search and enter the Usurped Island.
Confront the pirates and prove your bravery by recovering the stolen weapons. Your mission awaits you!

[b]Defeat Captain Low on the Usurped Island (5% chance to obtain Tier 3 Weapon Chest)
The event ends on Tuesday 05/03/25 at 22:00hs[/b]

notes.title: A howl in the darkness (Lore)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/b82eeea7bda30e4df319484fe2086a60a61c6eee.jpg[/img]

The wind blew hard on the ship's sails, dragging it through the clear southern waters. The last rays of the moon reflected the strong oak of the galley fighting against the waves, the departure from Nix had been easy but the northern tides were incredibly stronger.

On the deck, wrapped in a gray cloak, damp from the trip, with an old sabre hanging from his waist was Edric, an adventurer in search of power and glory. His blue eyes, hard as steel, were fixed on the horizon as the city of Arghal emerged from the morning mist. His final destiny lay in the forests to the west of those lands, where, according to ancient tales, fierce tigers lived whose souls could be claimed by the worthy, granting them the swiftness of the wind.

As he stepped onto the wooden dock eaten away by salt and time, Edric felt the weight of the city on his shoulders. The waters of the port, rough and thick, barely let in the light of an overcast sky. All around him, sullen-looking fishermen unloaded their nets, and men with faces weathered by the wind and tide drank in taverns where the stench of rum and fish filled the air. The alleys were narrow, impregnated with humidity, and the shadows seemed to move of their own accord. Something was not right here.

As he turned around the silent and imposing church of Arghal, he soon heard the murmur of the crowd gathered in the central square. Something had happened in the night, and unrest spread among the inhabitants like the clouds of a storm about to fall. Guided by curiosity, Edric advanced to the crowd and there, on an improvised podium, stood the governor of Arghal.

Lady Elanor dominated the scene with an imposing presence. His brown, almost reddish hair surrounded his features, and over his slender figure he wore a large burgundy cape, adorned with a golden emblem symbolizing the kingdom. His eyes, a deep and enigmatic brown, scanned the crowd with the sharpness of someone who has ruled in times of trouble.

[i]"Citizens of Arghal"[/i], his firm voice echoed through the square with unquestionable authority. "Last night we were attacked by a beast born of nightmares, a creature only spoken of in the tales of the elders. Bodolf has returned, and with him, our ruin if we do not do something. The gold of our city has been stolen, and with it, the last hope of maintaining the stability of our city."

A murmur ran through the crowd between doubts and fears. Edric frowned upon hearing the creature's name. He had heard rumors in the southern ports of a werewolf-like being who hunted in the darkest nights, leaving behind only bones and terror. The tales varied, however: some said Bodolf had been a man before his curse, others claimed he was an ancient spirit who fed on fear itself.
An old man, leaning on a gnarled staff, stepped forward through the crowd. His voice was raspy, as was his knowledge. [i]"If you wish to regain what is yours, you will not find it in this city. Bodolf has fled to his abode, the Cave of Desolation, beyond the shadowy hills. Go now, before he fades like mist at dawn."[/i]

Edric felt a chill run down his spine. He had come to seek the power of wild tigers, but fate seemed to be calling him to a different path. His eyes fell on the governor, whose frown reflected the gravity of the situation. Perhaps there, in Bodolf's lair, was a challenge worthy of his steel and a reward more valuable than simple gold.

The sun slowly rose, dyeing the roofs of Arghal amber. After a long sigh contemplating his options and filling himself with courage, Edric adjusted his sword belt, counted the potions in his bag and slowly turned his gaze towards you. [i]"I don't think I can do it alone. Will you join me, adventurer?" [/i]

notes.title: The Heart of the Red Dragon: The Forge of the Chosen
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/4816487bcee180593a959ffbb320f8cbf8c07754.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/40e61c2e47bedda7b610a39be411d3b2d5637e9e.png[/img]

In the vast lands of Argentum, where the winds blow with the force of
ancient secrets and the shadows of the past spread over the towns and mountains,
there is a place forgotten by most, but feared by all: the Dragon Dungeon.
This dungeon, which lies a few miles east of Nix and a few miles north of Arkhein,
opens in the bowels of the earth, beyond the cold and desolate plains. Surrounded by a rugged landscape,
where the echo of the beasts it houses resonates with every step, few dare to approach its entrance.
Those who have attempted to explore its depths tell stories of majestic but corrupted creatures,
of an unleashed fury that burns in the heart of the earth itself.
Red dragons now dwell within them, powerful and destructive beings that
once roamed free in the skies, but the power of an ancient evil took hold of them,
transforming their nature. The wrath and evil of the corrupted fire consumed their hearts,
turning them into beings of unstoppable destruction. Those who faced them fell before their power,
and the lands around them became barren, scorched by the eternal flames that spewed from their throats.

The kingdom of Banderbill, prosperous and strong, saw how this influenced the continent,
and the sun that once shone upon its fields darkened with each breath of the red dragons.
The warriors of King Tancred's court fell one after another, and the hope of the people faded.
The king, in desperation, sent messengers to all regions of the kingdom,
calling for those who possessed the courage to challenge the dragons and the evil that dwelled within the Dragon Dungeon.

"Whoever can traverse the depths of the Dungeon and defeat the red dragons," he proclaimed,
"will be rewarded with a gift greater than anything in Banderbill... a red dragon mount,
an eternal link to the very essence of the burning heavens."
Many answered the call, but few crossed the gates of the abyss.
Within, adventurers found themselves trapped in a labyrinth of darkness, fire, and enemies,
where flames burned endlessly, and the roar of beasts could be heard in every corner.
The red dragons, imposing and terrible, awaited those who dared to challenge their dominion.
But the bravest, those whose hearts burned with the desire to save their own lands or simply for power,
fought fiercely, facing the infernal creatures
and collecting the most precious fragments left in their wake: the burning hearts of the dragons.

Each heart, as it fell, released an ancient and powerful magic,
so pure and dangerous that only those with great mettle could approach it.
A heat so intense that it burned to the touch, but at the same time offered the promise of unimaginable power.
Those who managed to hold these hearts in their hands felt the energy of the creatures within them,
as if the very fire of the heavens had ignited in their chest.

In time, the most outstanding adventurers, those who bravely and sacrificially
collected the hearts of the fallen dragons, went to the ancient forges of the kingdom,
where ancient magic fused with the eternal flames of the Dungeon Dragon. There, in the crucible of the forge,
the hearts were transformed into something even greater: red dragon mounts.
Creatures forged from the very essence of primordial fire, whose wings burned with blinding intensity,
capable of soaring through the skies like no other.

Five notable heroes accomplished this feat,
riding the backs of red dragons.
However, their loyalty was not uniform.
Some of them did not share the interests of the kingdom of Banderbill or its ambitions.
These knights flew free, some seeking personal power,
others desiring adventure beyond the kingdom's borders.
Though their red dragon mounts made them imposing figures,
their destinies were not written; their own paths, and the echoes of their actions still resonate throughout Argentum.

The Dungeon Dragon is calmer, and its power, though weakened, remains latent.
Legends speak of a darkness that will never be completely extinguished,
that waits patiently in the shadows, waiting for its chance.

[b]- The whisper of darkness in the depths never dies -[/b]

Credits: Acid Snow

notes.title: News Update: A Grand Archive Transference!
notes.content:
[b]Hear ye, hear ye, brave adventurers of Argentum Online![/b]

Gather round as we share a momentous announcement from the realm!

Today, the sages of the Argentum Council shall embark upon a grand ritual known as [b]The Transference of the Great Archive[/b]. By the end of this day, the sacred Staging Grounds shall be imbued with an exact reflection of the mighty Production Realm. This means that your accounts, your hard-earned treasures, and your feats of glory will now exist in the testing lands of Staging!

[b]What Does This Mean for You?[/b]
- All adventurers will see a mirror of their Production accounts in the Staging Grounds.
- This enchanted land, reserved for testing and exploration, allows you to tread boldly without fear, testing new features and mechanics.

[b]Access to the Staging Grounds[/b]
As decreed by the Argentum Council, access to the Staging Grounds is bestowed upon our most loyal patrons—our [b]noble Patreon members[/b]—through the mystical [b]BETA Key[/b]. This key unlocks the gates to this alternate realm, where new horizons are explored, and the future of Argentum Online is shaped.

We thank thee, noble adventurers, for your continued support. With your aid, we strengthen the realm for generations to come. May your journeys in the Staging Grounds bring wisdom and feedback to fortify the Production Realm!

More info:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1956740/announcements/detail/4196862191899265180]https://steamcommunity.com/games/1956740/announcements/detail/4196862191899265180[/url]

[b]Stay vigilant,[/b]
The Argentum Online Dev Team

notes.title: Argentum Online in Microsoft New Zealand
notes.content:
[b]Adventurers of Argentum,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/967649e708e8f61acd194cc40d430368ed0bd329.jpg[/img]

Today we are filled with pride to announce an achievement worthy of immortal songs and stone carvings. Our fearless paladin, [b]Lucas Recoaro[/b], has carried the banner of [b]Argentum Online[/b] to the prestigious headquarters of [b]Microsoft in New Zealand, Aotearoa[/b].

In this gathering of wisdom and technological magic, the lecture titled: [b]“Embracing the Legacy: Learnings from Argentum Online”[/b] was presented. There, he unveiled the secrets of ancient technologies in this modern age dominated by cloud computing. [b]Argentum Online[/b], created with the arts of [b]Visual Basic 6 in 1999[/b], remains an indestructible fortress thanks to the passion of its community and the ingenuity of integrating modern spells like [b]Python[/b] and [b]Node.js[/b].

The challenges of keeping this legendary colossus alive were discussed: defending against fierce DDoS attacks, building cloud fortresses to ensure stability, and mastering the complex realms of CI/CD. Nothing is beyond the reach of this hero on his mission to honor the legacy!

Click the link below to view the full presentation: [url=https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embracing-legacy-learnings-from-argentum-online/274922180]View the full presentation here[/url]

Event link: [url=https://www.meetup.com/auckland-azure-usergroup/events/302067219]https://www.meetup.com/auckland-azure-usergroup/events/302067219[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/6d0cd3561de217721092838d1a6f58eca63a6d9f.jpg[/img]

[b]Applause for the Brave[/b]
This achievement honors every adventurer who has traversed the lands of Argentum. Without your courage and dedication, this legacy would not have stood the test of time.

Let the bards sing of this day and let heroes from all lands know: [b]The legacy of Argentum Online lives and will live forever in the hearts of its most loyal followers![/b]

To the glory of Argentum Online and for more adventures in this vast digital world!

notes.title: We are now accepting applications!

[b]Argentum Online[/b] has officially launched its [b]Ultimate Season[/b]! This time, there will be no more resets—your progress is here to stay.

notes.title: How will resource farming and crafting work in Argentum Online?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/483b62d910fedc9a0d3230b1452dfbd14c5f657d.jpg[/img]

On this occasion, we will share new information about the extraction and collection of Resources within Argentum Online:

[b]Tailoring:[/b]
From the start of the version there will be 3 types of skins within Argentum Online, with 2 copies of each, which are:

- Wolf Skin / Black Wolf Skin
- Brown Bear Skin / Polar Bear Skin
- Tiger Skin / Bengal Tiger Skin

These skins fall to the ground after killing the NPC in question, being farmable with any class within the game.

Link to the Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/sastreria

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Alchemy:[/b]
Worker characters will be able to craft various potions within Argentum Online, through this Quest system that will allow them to learn the Recipes for them.

The NPC Caelum, inside the city of Penthar, will offer us a quest system, where the rewards will be the Alchemy recipes, being only learnable by the Worker class.

At the beginning of the season, Life, Mana, Energy, Strength, Agility and Antidotes potions will be available for crafting.

Link to the Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/alquimia

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Carpentry:[/b]

The extraction of Firewood within Argentum Online is in Unsafe areas; there are two types of Firewood, Common and Elven.

- Common firewood is extracted within the Logging areas, which you can see in the REFERENCES section, within the game map, or in the manual section.

- Elven Wood is obtained from level 23, which is when the Worker class can use the Boat to Sail and access the Elven Forest.

The items that can be created with these two types of wood are found in the Carpentry section of the game manual.

Link to Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/talar
Carpentry: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/carpinteria

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Mining and Blacksmithing:[/b]

There are 4 types of minerals in Argentum Online: Coal, Iron, Silver and Gold.

- Coal is mined with a Worker in the Mines of Doom, north of Forgat
- Iron is mined in the Iron Mines, south of Ullathorpe
- Silver is mined on Otto Island, northwest of Nix, starting at level 23
- Gold is mined in Dungeon Veril, starting at level 33

Link to Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/minar
Blacksmith: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/herreria

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Fishing:[/b]
The obtaining of Gold through the sale of Fish is now oriented to the Unsafe zone. You can continue fishing in the Safe zone, but the profit will not be the same as always.
[b]Important clarification: [/b]Fishing Skills **DO NOT INCREASE** in the Safe zone.

Link to the Wiki: https://www.argentumonline.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/pescar

In the next few days we will continue to inform you more news about the next season, stay tuned for the announcements. Greetings!

notes.title: New season of Argentum Online now available!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers:

The new version of Argentum Online is now available! This new short season will have the following ratios:

x20 Experience
x10 Gold
x5 Gathering

There are countless changes incorporated into this new version in objects, NPCs, map, balance, etc. We recommend that you explore the game yourself, use the interactive map to inform yourself, and review the wiki: https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki

Some of the most important changes to highlight are:

1) You will find fewer navigable training areas. The reason is because the areas will be enabled over time through user surveys in the September x1 season. Meanwhile, in this version, enjoy meeting more often in the already enabled dungeons.

2) We have incorporated a ship transport system that allows players to travel from ships in Nix to Arghal, from Arghal to Forgat, and from Forgat to Nix. Some teleports hidden around the map were also incorporated that we encourage you to find on your own.

3) Cutting down wood is no longer safe. Balancing it with iron mining, firewood can now be obtained in certain areas of insecure forest: https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/guia-recoleccion/talar. We appreciate you testing this new update to continue improving the game.

4) More pets and spell for Druids. Now the Human Druid can tame up to Brown Bear and Stingray, the Elf Druid up to Tiger and Shark, and the Gnome up to Direwolf and Cryptocrocus: https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/domar. Also, a new spell was incorporated into the game only usable by Druids and purchasable in Eleusis.

5) Unarmed combat for the Bandit. Bandits will find themselves almost exclusively focused on unarmed combat, since now the critical hit and unequip will be activated with knuckles https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/guia-general/balance. Combat with weapons will remain as a secondary tool for training https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/guia-clases/manual-de-bandido.

6) All characters become visible when performing a melee hit on another character.

We appreciate your continued support.

Long live the AO!

The new version will have a short duration of 27 days (closes Thursday, August 1), so the multipliers will be:

We hope to have you and continue improving Argentum Online day by day, preparing in the best possible way for the long season of September 2024.

Argentum Online Staff

notes.title: BabelUI is now Open Source.
notes.content:
[u]BabelUI is now Open Source.[/u]

This is our engine to run the experimental UI

The purpose of this project is to add support for creating a React interface for a Visual Basic 6 application. To achieve this, we utilize Ultralight as the HTML engine. However, since the engine operates exclusively in 64-bit, and VB6 only runs in 32-bit, we have developed a 32-bit API for VB6. This API spawns a 64-bit background process to execute the HTML and employs shared memory to handle communication.

The solution is composed of 2 binaries:

[b]BabelUI.dll[/b]
This VB6 API module handles the spawning of child processes and converts all VB6 calls into events that can be processed by the background process.

[b]BabelSlave.exe[/b]
The main function of this executable is to render the HTML content. Additionally, it renders the current HTML state to a buffer and sends it to the API for display within the VB6 application. This process also manages the loading of game resources, allowing the HTML to display game content seamlessly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/6927be5a330c888d56c5158be69706273ec19f96.png[/img]

- VB6 uses the API interface to send any user interactions such as mouse movements, key presses, or any other actions required by the client logic from the UI, such as changing menus.
- Since VB6 is single-threaded, we cannot directly call UI events. Instead, BabelApi stores all pending events from the UI (such as button presses). Then, VB6 requests an update from the main thread, and all callbacks are executed.
- BabelApi converts all API calls to events and stores them in shared memory.
- BabelSlave retrieves all events from the shared memory and calls the required functions in JavaScript, handle any js function callback and send it back to the api, it also load any resource required by the game like icons for the inventory

https://github.com/ao-org/BabelUI

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/31162ffff2ad0dc28fc8f73960ef530bd7ed4841.png[/img]
