notes.title: Black Dragon Season
notes.content:
[b]Black Dragon Season[/b]

It will begin on March 1 at 00:00 for Patreons members, and on March 2 at 00:00 access will be enabled for the general public.

[list]
[*] The season will last 60 days
[*] The experience modifier will be x4
[*] The extraction modifier will be x2
[*] Gold modifier remains at x1
[/list]

[b]Class Balance:[/b]
The balance modifications can be seen in the wiki (https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/balance) and are already reflected in the production server. You are invited to update the game, review them and leave us your feedback so we can finish polishing it between now and 1/3.

[b]Patreons:[/b]
Patreon shop item credits reduced! The new prices can be seen from the wiki (https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/items-patreon) or by visiting the Mesón Hostigado within the game.
Starting March 1st, new mounts exclusive to the Patreon shop will be added: the Reins of Dragons. The Young Dragon Reins will cost 1000 credits and the Adult Dragon Reins will cost 1250 credits.
The new reins, like the Backpacks currently are, will be non-transferable. They are acquired with the character they are going to use and cannot be thrown away or traded with another user.
Coming soon: limit of character slots in the account. Those who support the project with Patreon will be able to have access to more slots to create characters.


[b]Theme of the Season:[/b]
The action of the version will be centered on a new +40 map within the Dragon Dungeon where, those who want to get the Black Dragon Season Set, will fight tirelessly against dragons and other users for dominance of the map. Upon death, new NPCs will have a chance to drop their claws and quests will be enabled to exchange them for a Season item for your class. Once the season ends, these Black Dragon items will no longer be available as Black Dragon drops as they were until today, giving way to a new version of Argentum Online, with a different seasonal theme.
Its opening is planned for the fourth week of the version, so it is recommended to take advantage of the start of the game to rise to level 40, organize with your clan and prepare for battle!

[b]Items: [/b]
Beginner Items: All classes in the game will start with their own set of what they will equip throughout the game.
There were major changes in the balance of items, their main parameters, where to get them, and what class they belong to, differentiating them by tiers or levels:
tier 0: beginner equipment
tier 1: equipment for sale for levels -25
tier 2: equipment on sale for levels +25
tier 3: craftable equipment
Tier 4: Legendary Chest Gear
Tier 5: Black Dragon Team (starting in the fourth week)
All updated item information will be found in the new class manuals, soon available on discord and the wiki. These manuals will allow you to reduce all the existing items in the game to those that can be equipped by a particular class, facilitating the knowledge of your character.

[b]NPCs:[/b]
The statistics (HP, EXP, GOLD) of the NPCs in the following areas have been modified:
Newbie Dungeon
Nix Archipelago
Cemetery
Pyramid
Dungeon Dragon
Naga Island
Swamp
Eleusis
New Hope
Sea of Leviathans
Mountain
Elven Forest
Pythonisa Island
Forest and Sea NPCs that don't belong in a dungeon
5 Clan Foundation: changes in the requirements to found a clan. Now you can found someone who is level 25, has 35 points assigned in Leadership, and has the 4 Foundation Gems, items obtainable with a 100% droprate by defeating:
Drain Boss → Har Nareth 100,000 HP // Drop 100% Green Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 2 badges)
Earost Ruins Boss: Giant Kraken 100,000 HP // Drop 100% Blue Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 2 badges)
Swamp Boss → Grim Titan 200,000 HP // Drop 100% Red Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 3 badges)
Polar Gulf Boss: Etzbron Frostwind 200,000 HP // Drop 100% Polar Gem + Blue or Red Badge (can drop 3 badges)
Fact: The Gorgon Queen (Boss of Pythoness Island +40) can drop up to 4 insignia, but she does not drop an item necessary for the founding of the clan.

[b]Mapping:[/b]
The Magma Dungeon will remain closed for the entire version (it is likely that it will disappear from the map in one of the patches for this version, or in a future one, to make way for the emergence of another training place)
The island of Pythonisa will remain the only exclusive training location for levels +40, maintaining certain NPCs and new additions (this change is already reflected in the game currently).
Access to Jourmut was disabled, entering a new stage of development to implement it in future versions, in a more optimal and balanced way.
Access to Eldoria, the city of the Elves, is maintained through a portal east of Ullathorpe.
Quest:
The training areas will have their own quests, with which the gold reward will be encouraged, and in turn, those that have the property of being repeatable, will generate an incentive for those who wish to progress to a faster level.
The Special Class Skills quests from last season have been disabled: they will not be available this season, but they may be reinstated in the future with better balance and testing.

[b]Alchemy:[/b]
This new system will offer the possibility of crafting potions to those who wish to do so. It will begin with the availability of the recipes for life and mana potions, only purchasable for the Worker class, and as the seasons progress, the rest will be added. The information will be available soon on the Wiki.

[b]Tailoring:[/b]
Adjustments were made to the skin requirements on certain tailoring items, and Tiger Skin and Bengal Tiger Skin were added to the game.
The information is available at https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/sastreria

[b]Carpentry:[/b]
Updated the wood requirements for carpentry items, their values, and for some items, their attack statistics were modified. The information is available at https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/carpinteria

[b]Legendary Chests:[/b]
Spell Chest temporarily disabled: Legendary Spells are under review to give each spell a better balance.
The Legendary Armor Chest was updated: changes in the defense values of some of them, reduction in their magic resistance to 1%, and class assignment of each one.
The Helmets and Shields Chest was divided into two independent chests where each class will have at least one legendary item, except for shields for the mage and druid and both for the worker.
[b]Spells:[/b]
Disabled special abilities for each class in the latest version
Added a starting base damage spell for all mana classes - this requires 0 magic to use.
Modifications were made to where each spell is purchased and its damage, the information is available at https://www.ao20.com.ar/wiki/hechizos

[b]Factions:[/b]
The regulations of both factions were modified, these are available in PDF format in the faction section of the Official Discord and on the web.
Modified the defenses of the Factional Armors / Tunics
Changed the requirements for Faction Hierarchies.
[IMPORTANT] The factional pardon was eliminated: those users who wish to enlist in a faction and have an impediment due to having murdered a member of the same, will not be able to request the factional pardon. If the character is acquired via MAO, neither; The statistics of a character's deaths in the MAO are public, for everyone to see.

[b]PVP:[/b]
The manual deletion of the magic words (sign) is re-enabled, but maintaining the automatic deletion with a minimum time.
Invisibility will no longer go away when attacking, returning to classic invi.
A nerf was applied to the Magic Resistance skill, so that having it at 0 does not take excessive magic damage.
Removed magic penetration from staffs, flutes, and lauds, which disabled magic resistance items such as hats, helmets, or rings.

notes.title: Enabling access to the Argentum Online STAGING Server
notes.content:
Below we attach the instructions to access our Staging server, which allows you to verify and review everything that is about to be updated on the Production server.
The code to enter is exclusive for Patreon and members of the Argentum Online Staff

1) We open Steam, right click on [b]Argentum Online[/b]
2) We select and click [b]Properties[/b]
3) Then we select [b]Betas[/b] and paste the access code, once entered we click on [b]VERIFY CODE[/b]
4) Finally, in the [b]"Beta participation"[/b] option we select [b]"beta - Staging Server"[/b]

[strike]Activate the experimental UI as soon as the client starts, choose Staging:
1) Open the OUTPUT folder located in the local game installation files: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Argentum 20\Argentum20\Resources\OUTPUT
2) Edit the Configuration.ini file, look within [OPTIONS] for the last field that says:
UseExperimentalUI=0 and pass it to UseExperimentalUI=1 Save changes!
3) Open the game as usual[/strike]

Once you have switched to the Staging branch, you will need to use the following data to connect:

Staging IP: 45.235.98.188 -- Port: 6501

This way you will be able to enter the test server and see everything that is coming very soon. To re-enter the production server you will have to deselect BETA in the BETAS settings.

notes.title: Important announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/caafbbb2b9c07ac32b4f130359c8dfd7ace933fc.png[/img]

Dear users:

We want to share with you an important announcement, but before this we will do a brief review of what the current version left us with.
[i]The version under the name AO20 was launched in September 2023, presenting as a novelty the new continent of Jourmut, with numerous safe areas to train without risks. Additionally, new skills were added along with some balance adjustments based on them.
We understand that many of these changes have not been to the liking of many players and many others were not implemented, due to the attacks that the server suffered at its beginning, which made us focus our energies on guaranteeing stability.
Luckily we were able to solve it and for several days we have been working on polishing and saving new things to implement in the coming seasons.[/i]
[b]We are convinced that nothing would have been possible without your support and especially our Patreon users who, thanks to their contributions and trust, were able to provide the quality of hosting that the game deserves.[/b]

We want to inform you that starting [b]March 1[/b], a [b]new season[/b] will begin in [b]Argentum Online[/b].
That day active Patreons will be able to log in with their account and start playing early while on [b]March 2 general access will be enabled[/b].

[i]The new dynamic that we will implement will consist of a considerably increased experience, with short seasons of two months and a special theme for each of them.
We are devising a rewards system based on Ranking that will allow us to highlight the best players of each season by offering them special recognition and benefits in the following season.
In this period leading up to the start date, we will continue to work on balance adjustments to ensure a gaming experience consistent with the new season length.[/i]

[b]We hope to have your support![/b]
Argentum Online Staff

notes.title: Argentum Online
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/caafbbb2b9c07ac32b4f130359c8dfd7ace933fc.png[/img]

Argentum Online, also known as AO, is an open-source project, whose last "official" change was made on July 17th, 2012 (v0.13).

From our end, we created an anniversary version for the 20 years of Argentum Online in 2020, which, thanks to people's support, is still alive. This effort also aimed to give the community the opportunity to create their own version of Argentum Online and submit improvements, by creating an active Github organization where the project's source code and all necessary tools are available to everyone.

We, as the current maintainers of the project in this year when AO will turn 24, want to remind the community of the opportunity to collaborate with the project, where everyone is invited to participate in its development by submitting improvements, changes, fixes, among other things, in order to preserve and continue evolving this cultural phenomenon.

As part of our changes and implementations in the workflow, we will carry out the following in the project:


[list]
[*] Argentum20 will be renamed Argentum Online.
[*] We will use the domain [url=http://www.argentumonline.com.ar/]http://www.argentumonline.com.ar/[/url].
[*] In each new release, both server and client, we will upload the executables so that you can create private servers locally.
[*] Historical preservation: all changelogs (changes) from the original repositories will be migrated so that anyone who has contributed to the source code of Argentum Online on Sourceforge will appear on Github (more information [url=https://medium.com/@requitolucas/importar-repositorio-cvs-a-git-sourceforge-a-github-de-manera-fácil-20c63344bfa5]Click here for more information[/url]).
[/list]
Thank you very much to everyone for the support.
Argentum Online

notes.title: Security advice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/b6f189846d3bf418bea988a7260dbc539b4f29c8.jpg[/img]

We want to share with you some recommendations so that together we can maintain the security of both the server and your accounts.

We are continually working on the security of our server, even so we must take care of the human factor and protect ourselves from attacks. To do this, players must be careful with:

• The installation of games and tools that do not come from a secure gaming service such as Steam, GOG, Epic, etc.
• Downloading executables and installers of unknown origin.
• Security flaws in other games that could have allowed the violation of their database and the extraction of sensitive information.
• Creating accounts in other games and services with the same password.
• Share the account or character to third parties who have done any of the points mentioned above.

Actions you can take to improve the security of your accounts and privacy in general:

• Download and update antivirus or antimalware software on your PCs to eliminate any possible threats.
• Periodically change your account passwords. To do so, open the client, access the "Account" section and select the "Recover Password" option.
• Do not use the same passwords in all games and services. If you did, consider changing your password as soon as possible.
• If you do not want to install an antivirus/antimalware, you can scan the executables and installers with the website https://virustotal.com/ to check for any viruses/malware.

Staff AO20

notes.title: Notice from Noland Studios
notes.content:
We want to let you know that we are continuing to make changes to the game with the goal of bringing the experience as close as possible to our desired vision at launch. We understand that not all aspects will be able to be optimized in this short period, and it is likely that there will be elements that we will continue to work on in later versions. However, we are working tirelessly to get as close as possible to our goals.
We'd like to address some concerns that have been brought to our attention and clarify some points that we've noted in player feedback. First of all, we want to emphasize that none of these changes are final. If our future evaluation indicates so, we are willing to reverse decisions.
In relation to the modifications in creatures, settings, mechanics and other elements, we are carrying them out with the intention of finding a balance between the oldest users and the newcomers. It is essential to understand that we are creating a game that reflects our vision as a development team. It is impossible to please everyone, considering the different ages, preferences of veteran and new players, as well as attitudes towards change.
We are aware that we will not be able to satisfy everyone, despite our wishes. The game in question, like the world of AO, is shaped by our development vision. This is what makes the game exceptionally wonderful. There are easier servers, others more challenging, some follow the traditional AO guidelines and others distance themselves from them completely. In our case, as a development team, we consider a change of approach and the modernization of certain aspects crucial, and we are committed to that direction.

We will continue advancing in the same line that we have traced during these three years. Despite the obstacles we have faced, we continue to work tirelessly to provide you with the best gaming experience possible.
We invite you to leave us your opinion on the direction of the game in a respectful way and trying to substantiate it to better understand the different opinions

Atte.

Staff Noland Studios

notes.title: We start with the BETA of the new season of AO20!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/907639ef0f334b81f03eb720db16f7044e5bca46.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We bring you news about the BETA version of the upcoming season of AO20. Before going into details, let's remember some important dates and technical aspects:

The BETA version will be available until September 06. During these weeks, we will be making changes to experience and in-game gold earning so that everyone can easily try out the new things we have implemented.

[i]Here are the variations for each week:[/i]

  [list]
[*] Week from 08/01 to Tuesday 08: Experience and gold multiplied by 5.
[*] Week from 08/08 to Tuesday 15: Experience and gold multiplied by 10.
  [*] Week from 08/15 to Wednesday 06/09: Experience multiplied by 15.
[/list]
It is essential for us to receive your queries and reports about any bugs or errors you find while playing the BETA version. With your feedback, we will be able to make any necessary adjustments to make the AO20 experience optimal.

On [b]09/07[/b], active patrons will have the exclusive chance to create characters and start playing the final version 24 hours before the rest.

Finally, on [b]09/08[/b], everyone must create new accounts and characters to access the final version of the new season of AO20.

[b]We hope you enjoy this BETA and help us improve AO20 with your feedback! See you in the game![/b]

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ----------

[u][b]List of Changes:[/b][/u]


[b]Invisible Attack:[/b] Attacking while invisible will now turn you visible for a few seconds, adding a tactical element and balancing the use of this ability.

[b]Wallet Changes:[/b] to ensure you don't lose the gold you carry with you. Now, the wallet has a capacity to cover up to 7.5k gold per level, which means that you will be able to protect a considerable amount of your earnings. If the gold in your wallet is covered by your level it will be painted yellow, otherwise it will be red and you can lose your gold if you are killed.

[b]Changes in life: [/b]life is always maintained on average, respecting the stats of the race and class selected in the character.

[b]Damage on Stab:[/b] The damage dealt by stab attacks has been halved to prevent instant kills and balance the impact of the new Assassin poisons. This measure also seeks to encourage the use of different variants of daggers.

[b]Equipment and Training:[/b] These changes are intended to incentivize mages to better equip themselves to improve their performance in training and face stronger challenges.

[b]Evasion and Hit Chance:[/b] Reduced the evasion of all classes equally to increase the chance to hit enemies overall. Chance to hit is now set to 50% as a baseline.

[b]Summons:[/b] The power of summons will now depend on the mage's level. Additionally, the damage dealt by summons will be influenced by the staff the mage is holding at the time they are summoned.

[b]Player Magic Resist:[/b] Players now have a new "Magic Resist" skill that will allow them to mitigate the effects of enemy spells.

[b]Magic Resist for Creatures:[/b] Added the "Magic Resist" attribute to creatures. Players will need to take this factor into account when launching magical attacks against them. Damage dealt will be reduced by 2% for each point of difference between the player's magic ability and the creature's magic resist.

[b]Factions and Points System:[/b] A new points-based faction system has been introduced. Players get points for killing other characters, but the number of points depends on the level difference between the attacker and the target. Assists also award points, but in smaller amounts. The last five players to have killed a character will not gain additional points for killing them again.

[b]Targeting in Party Portraits:[/b] Re-enabled targeting in party portraits, making it easier to coordinate and track allies in combat.

[b]Mage Rods and Spells:[/b] All mage rods will affect spell performance. It is no longer necessary to possess certain types of staff/staff/wand to cast spells. Additionally, all staves will now increase damage as described in their descriptions, removing the previous 30% penalty.

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ----------

[u][b]New skills by Class[/b][/u]

[b][u]Pirate:[/u][/b]
Firearms ignore enemies' armor.

[b]Harpoon: [/b]Deals damage and applies a "slow" effect that slows the target for several seconds.
[b]Pocket Cannon: [/b]Fires a cannonball that explodes upon hitting the target, dealing area damage. Damage decreases as you move away from the center of the explosion.

[b][u]Cleric:[/u][/b]
[b]Restoration:[/b] Heals between 25-40 health every 1.5 seconds, casting a total of 8 heals.
[b]Divine Protection:[/b] Grants a shield that absorbs up to 200 damage to the target. Lasts 30 seconds or until shield depletes.
[b]Blessing:[/b] Removes a debuff from the target.
[b]Penance:[/b] Mark the target; the next damage taken by the target does 120% damage.

[u][b]Druid:[/b][/u]
[b]Restoration:[/b] Heals between 25-40 health every 1.5 seconds, casting a total of 8 heals.
[b]Regrowth:[/b] The target receives extra healing from all sources (spells, potions, etc.). Requires the Forest Spirit form.
[b]Rend:[/b] Applies a bleed that deals damage over time.
[b]Fast Movement: [/b]Increases movement speed for a few seconds. Requires Wolf form.

[b]Transformations:[/b]
[b]Wolf:[/b] Increases evasion and chance to hit, but does not allow casting magic on other targets (only on itself).
[b]Bear:[/b] Reduces damage taken by 20%, reduces damage dealt with magic by 30%, and increases chance to hit.
[b]Forest Spirit:[/b] Increases magic damage by 5% and heals done by 10%. Consumes more mana while active and slows movement speed.

[u][b]Bard:[/b][/u]
[b]Scores: [/b]Applies a buff to self and nearby party members.
[b]Regeneration:[/b] Regenerates a percentage of mana per second.
[b]Fast Echo:[/b] Increases movement speed.
[b]Harmonic Accuracy:[/b] Increases the chance to hit.
[b]Edge Serenade:[/b] Increases character's evasion.

[u][b]
Bandit:[/b][/u]
[b]Quick Hits:[/b] The next 3 hits deal 3 hits for 40% of the damage.
[b]Steal Magic:[/b] Steals a buff from the target and applies it to himself.

[u][b]Murderer:[/b][/u]
[b]Poisons: [/b]Applies a poison to the weapon that inflicts an effect on the target when hit.
[b]Mana Poison:[/b] Applies a buff that drains a percentage of mana every second.
[b]Stackable Poison:[/b] Applies a poison on each hit that does 15-25 damage per second. It can be applied multiple times, accumulating the damage dealt. Has a bonus chance to hit with daggers.

[u][b]Warrior:[/b][/u]
[b]Viking Axe:[/b] You can hit in melee or throw it to cause a "stun" that lasts approximately 1 second.
[b]Phalanx: [/b]Reduces damage taken by 50% and damage dealt by 25%.
[b]Extended Cut:[/b] Allows you to hit multiple targets at once with reduced damage. Hits 75% of the target in front and 50% of those to the sides of it.
[b]Taunt: [/b]Applies a buff to all enemies in the area, reducing their damage to other targets and prompting them to attack the warrior. Slows the warrior's movement speed and prevents him from turning invisible.

[u][b]Hunter:[/b][/u]
[b]Charged Arrow: [/b]Deals a small amount of damage and pushes the target several tiles away.
[b]Arrow Dance:[/b] Fires 5 arrows that spread out in a cone in the direction of the target, hitting whatever is in the way. Each arrow does 30% damage.
[b]Traps:[/b] Allows you to leave up to 3 traps on the ground. Each lasts up to 2 minutes or until someone steps on them.
[b]Root:[/b] Applies "Root" to the target.
[b]Explosive: [/b]Explodes and deals damage to the target when activated.
[b]Poison:[/b] Applies poison to the target upon stepping on it.

notes.title: New season at Argentum20!
notes.content:
This new version is loaded with amazing implementations and features that will elevate your gaming experience. Before we get into all the details, there is one important matter that we need to address.
Due to the significant improvements and changes in the game system, it will be necessary to perform a complete whitewashing of the existing characters in the database. We understand that this may be disappointing for some, especially those who have invested time and effort into developing their characters. However, this measure is necessary to ensure optimal compatibility and stability of the new version.
But let's get that little hurdle out of the way and talk about the amazing improvements this new season brings. We have worked hard to optimize game performance, improve gameplay, and add fresh and exciting content for you to explore. Get ready to immerse yourself in a new continent with completely revamped graphics and creatures, full of challenging missions and special abilities that will take the combat system to new heights. These are just some of the features that await you in this new version.
We are sure that we will exceed all your expectations and keep you captivated for endless hours of gaming. We want to sincerely thank you for your continued support of our project, without you this would not be possible!

IMPORTANT: Patreon in-game credits will be preserved in the new version

📅 Now, write down the important dates on your calendar!

➡ ️ On July 31, the database will be cleaned, keeping the active patreon accounts and their credits, but without characters. From that moment, the Beta of the new version will begin.
➡ ️ On September 07, once the Beta is finished, another laundering of the database will be carried out to start the official launch of the version. It will have early access for all active patreon accounts that will allow them to create their characters to reserve the Nick.
➡️ On September 08, the public launch of the new version will take place.

We would love to have all of you in this exciting new season of Argentum20. Get ready to discover a world full of adventures and challenges! See you on the new continent!

Sincerely,
The Argentum20 development team

notes.title: Multi-event Fridays at AO20
notes.content:
On Fridays at 10:00 p.m. (GMT -3) we will do the already classic day of multi-events in AO20, you can follow it on [url=https://twitch.tv/PlusAO20]Plus De Ulla's Twitch[/url], to participate must send /GM or /PARTICIPATE as it appears in the console

[b]🩸 Deathmatch [/b]
The event consists of facing several enemies in a ring where red and blue potions appear while the event lasts, it lasts 6 minutes, each kill made gives you 3 points, each kill received subtracts 1 point, the one that achieves the best score with these variables will win the event.

[b]🦶 Last Standing [/b]
To participate in this event, the GM in charge will indicate a keyword by console, it will allow you to access the event by /GM, once summoned you must wait for the GM to finish summoning all the participants and at that moment a free-roam battle, the first one to stand 3 times will be the winner of the event.

[b]🚩 🏳️ Flag Capture [/b]
The event consists of stealing the flag from the opposing team's base, taking it to your team's and keeping it for 10 seconds. The one who manages to repeat these steps 3 times wins the event.

[b]🐍 Day of the stick [/b]
This event consists of eliminating as many snakes as possible with your club, some are more difficult to kill than others and give more points, the one who achieves the best score will win the event.

[b]🗡️ Russian Dagger [/b]
This event concentrates a certain number of users, they are grouped in a row and go one by one (without clothes or items that defend) the last to be stabbed will win the event.

[b] 🏃‍♂️ Racing [/b]
This variable event will consist of a race from point X to point Y such as from Ulla to Bander, from Nix to Ulla, from Arkheim to Bander, etc...the first to reach the destination indicated by the GM organizer will win the event.

[b] 💥 Maze [/b]
This event consists of being the smartest and fastest to escape from a maze that we have hidden in the game, to add more difficulty, HOSTILE NPCS will appear along the way, the first to reach the goal will win.

[b] 🎯 Hunting [/b]
In this event, the participants will be summoned to a specific map where they will face various HOSTILE NPCs. The objective of the event is to survive, the NPC cannot be attacked, you will only be allowed to remove yourself and immobilize your enemies, the winner will be the one who manages to stay alive until the end in 3 opportunities.

notes.title: 4/2/23 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/979f467e211d139c9f3e570e6d129efaa008abe4.jpg[/img]

[b]News:[/b]

•Added a new type of consumable item, which allows you to instantly craft 1000 units of bullets or a specific type of arrow.
They are available within the list of buildable objects through the blacksmith or carpentry respectively.

•Consuming 5 beers and/or wines in a short period of time produces a drunken effect that causes you to lose control of your movements for 40 seconds. It is increased by 20 seconds for each additional consumption.

[b]Changes:[/b]

•No magic points are needed to cast "Magic Dart". Instead, "Cure Poison" requires 5 magic points.

•Characters that share a party cannot attack each other.

•Decreased the power of the sound played when casting "Dragon's Breath".

•We've made visual improvements to the “Socketed Staff” graphic. It is thinner and more opaque. In addition, it has a powerful sapphire embedded inside.

•We increased the cost of the "Glasses". Before they cost 100 credits and now they cost 300 Patreon credits. Additionally, they do not drop from inventory upon death.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

• “Imperial”, “Banderbill Council” and “Citizen” status characters can use the “Sacred Reliquary” to revive each other.

•You cannot cast “Heroism” or “War Cry” on a user other than the one who casts the spell.

•We removed some graphic details that were on the water of ”Cueva de las Nagas” (303; 304; 305 and 208).

•The "Old Fishing Book" which is located at coordinates 74-74 of the "Puerto de Pescadores" (254) has no limit on the number of fish that can be delivered simultaneously.

•We improved the impact effect of firearms.

•Punctuation marks and/or special characters can be included within the clan description.

•We removed and applied a series of blockades on the following locations: “North Sea” (362); "Forest" (186); "Usurped Island" (100); "Desert" (203); "Banderbill Jail" (66); "Penthar" (560); “Entrance Dungeon Marabel” (76); "High Seas" (456); "Kraken Ruins of Earost" (285); “Wood East of Ullathorpe” (11); “Catacombs Lvl2” (291; 292 and 293) and “Drain” (382; 388; 376; 321; 337; 336; 335; 334; 329; 332; 328; 331; 327; 325; 384 and 333).

[i]About the last two, the transition between the corresponding maps was also added.[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes Deployed 02/04/23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257939/979f467e211d139c9f3e570e6d129efaa008abe4.jpg[/img]

News of the patch implemented on 02/04/23

• When sending a private message to another player, a message is displayed indicating that the player is too far away or is not online.

• While the player is dead, you cannot remove items from the player's inventory.


Balance:

• Reduced the amount of time magic words are displayed when a player casts a spell while invisible. They used to appear for 500 milliseconds (½ second) and now they appear for 375 milliseconds (⅜ of a second).

• We increased the mana and energy cost of ”Toxic Particles”. Previously it consumed 400 mana and 100 energy whereas now it consumes 750 mana and 400 energy.

• We increased the mana cost of “Summon Pet: Bear; Tiger; Worg and Shark. Previously they consumed 250 mana and now they consume 750.


Error correction:

• Unarmed Combat no longer ignores the attacker's hit chance and the target's evasion.

• As long as a player does not deactivate the corresponding lock, he cannot be resurrected with the Holy Reliquary.

• Damage dealt by Toxic Particles impacts and refreshes directly on the target's health the moment it is received.

• We disabled the sounds played when entering the map “North Sea” (134), located to the left of the “Isla del Averno” (133).

• You can correctly enter the "Dark Temple" (286), a church located at coordinates 76-26 of the "City of Arkheim" (195).

• We removed some blocks from the “Cave of the Gorgons” (311) and blocked most of the corners of the structures present on said map.

notes.title: NEW SUPER PATCH
notes.content:
[u][b]News:[/b][/u]

We added a new functionality: character transfer.
It can only be done if both users are members of Patreon and if the owner of the character has a total of 2,000 points, which will be discounted.

Every time there is an error trying to log in with a character, the server will automatically try to reconnect to avoid having to go back to the previous menu.

New NPC added: "Messi", which allows you to acquire the substitute shirt of the Argentina team. Additionally, the merchant in the Patreon store, located in the harassed Banderbill inn, will allow you to get an alternative version of said jersey, which includes its own matching ball.


[b]Conection error:[/b]

Any spell that is displayed in red will no longer be learnable.

Adjusted restrictions on Summon Pet spells: Bear; tiger; shark and direwolf so that now each race can only learn and use those spells that allow them to summon creatures that they are capable of taming.

You can leave, invite, and kick members of a group without having to log out and rejoin.

Changed the motif and colors of the various fireworks.


[b]Visual changes:[/b]

Most of the armor of the different classes and hierarchies of the royal army was replaced and redesigned.

We will make similar adjustments to the Dark Legion armor in a future update.

The garbage can that is located at the bottom left of the inventory is visible again.

The text “Empowered”, which indicates the remaining time of haste or force effects, is now located on the right of the screen. In addition, it will be shown in yellow when 15 seconds remain and in red when only the last 10 seconds remain.

Adjusted the position of different graphics such as: the tiger helmet; the wolf helmet; the elite hood, as well as that of some bodies, among others.
